top_matches.tested_construct: CYP7A1 encodes cholesterol 7alpha-hydroxylase, which catalyzes the initial and rate-controlling step of the classic bile-acid synthesis pathway from cholesterol. Loss of CYP7A1 reduces bile-acid production and cholesterol catabolism, promoting hepatic cholesterol accumulation, increased LDL cholesterol, and gallstone/atherosclerotic risk.
top_matches.educational_objective: Identify CYP7A1 as the enzyme initiating the classic bile-acid synthesis pathway by 7alpha-hydroxylating cholesterol.

reports.proposed_construct: Molybdenum cofactor deficiency causes combined loss of sulfite oxidase and xanthine dehydrogenase activity, producing sulfite accumulation with low uric acid and severe neonatal encephalopathy
reports.proposed_objective: Use a shared cofactor requirement to unify abnormalities in sulfur-amino-acid and purine metabolism.

top_matches.tested_construct: Xanthine dehydrogenase catalyzes the final two steps of purine degradation: hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to uric acid. XDH loss therefore causes profound hypouricemia/hypouricosuria with xanthine accumulation and xanthine nephrolithiasis.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect XDH deficiency with failure of terminal purine oxidation, profound hypouricemia, and xanthine nephrolithiasis.

top_matches.tested_construct: MOCS1 participates in the first step of molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis, converting GTP to cyclic pyranopterin monophosphate. Loss of molybdenum cofactor disables sulfite oxidase and other molybdoenzymes; sulfite accumulation is the major driver of severe neonatal neurotoxicity.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link MOCS1-related molybdenum cofactor deficiency to impaired sulfite oxidation and neurotoxic sulfite accumulation.

top_matches.tested_construct: Deficiency of branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase prevents oxidative decarboxylation of leucine, isoleucine, and valine metabolites, causing neurotoxic accumulation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Relate neonatal encephalopathy with sweet-smelling urine to failure of branched-chain amino acid catabolism.

top_matches.tested_construct: ADA deficiency causes accumulation of toxic purine metabolites, including deoxyadenosine-derived nucleotides, which are particularly toxic to developing lymphocytes and cause severe combined immunodeficiency.
top_matches.educational_objective: Relate ADA deficiency to toxic purine-metabolite accumulation and combined T- and B-cell immunodeficiency.

top_matches.tested_construct: Restoration of molybdenum-cofactor-dependent sulfite oxidase activity
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect cPMP replacement in MOCS1 deficiency with restoration of molybdenum cofactor and sulfite oxidase function.

top_matches.tested_construct: HGPRT deficiency blocks salvage of hypoxanthine and guanine, increasing de novo purine synthesis and uric acid production while causing severe neurologic and behavioral abnormalities.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect self-injury and hyperuricemia to defective purine salvage.

top_matches.tested_construct: CYP27A1 loss causing mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency with reduced bile-acid synthesis and cholestanol accumulation
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis as CYP27A1-dependent mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency that impairs bile-acid synthesis and causes cholestanol accumulation.

top_matches.tested_construct: Thiamine deficiency impairs thiamine-dependent oxidative metabolism in vulnerable brain regions, producing confusion, ocular motor abnormalities, and gait ataxia.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Wernicke encephalopathy from the classic thiamine-deficiency neurologic triad.

reports.proposed_construct: IRAK4 deficiency disrupts MyD88-dependent Toll-like receptor and IL-1 receptor signaling, causing recurrent pyogenic bacterial infection with blunted fever and acute-phase responses
reports.proposed_objective: Connect IRAK4 kinase function with innate NF-kappaB signaling and muted inflammation during invasive bacterial infection.

top_matches.tested_construct: MYD88 is a shared intracellular adaptor for most Toll-like receptors and most IL-1 receptor family members; loss predisposes to invasive pyogenic bacterial infection
top_matches.educational_objective: MYD88 is the shared adaptor for most Toll-like receptor and most IL-1 receptor family signaling; loss impairs early innate inflammatory responses and predisposes to recurrent invasive pyogenic bacterial infection.

top_matches.tested_construct: Biotinidase deficiency prevents efficient recycling of biotin, reducing activity of multiple biotin-dependent carboxylases and causing neurologic and cutaneous disease.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect biotinidase deficiency with impaired carboxylase function.

top_matches.tested_construct: CSF2RA encodes the alpha subunit of the GM-CSF receptor. Loss of effective GM-CSF signaling impairs terminal function of alveolar macrophages, particularly surfactant catabolism and clearance, causing intra-alveolar surfactant accumulation and hypoxemic respiratory disease.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect CSF2RA-related hereditary pulmonary alveolar proteinosis with impaired GM-CSF-dependent surfactant clearance by alveolar macrophages.

top_matches.tested_construct: MEFV pathogenic variants dysregulate pyrin inflammasome activity and interleukin-1-mediated innate inflammation, causing recurrent self-limited fever and serositis.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish autoinflammatory FMF from adaptive autoimmune disorders.

top_matches.tested_construct: Gain-of-function TRPC6 variants increase cation current and calcium entry in podocytes, perturbing calcium-dependent signaling and cytoskeletal homeostasis and causing autosomal-dominant FSGS.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect dominant TRPC6 gain-of-function variants to increased podocyte calcium entry and familial FSGS.

top_matches.tested_construct: Adrenergic detrusor relaxation during bladder filling
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect beta-3 receptor activation to the bladder storage phase.

top_matches.tested_construct: Restoration of molybdenum-cofactor-dependent sulfite oxidase activity
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect cPMP replacement in MOCS1 deficiency with restoration of molybdenum cofactor and sulfite oxidase function.

top_matches.tested_construct: Activated CD4+ T cells express CD40 ligand (CD154), which binds CD40 on B cells and provides an essential signal for germinal-center responses and immunoglobulin class switching. Loss of CD40L prevents effective switching from IgM to IgG, IgA, and IgE and also impairs other CD40-dependent immune functions, predisposing to recurrent pyogenic and opportunistic infections.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize CD40 ligand deficiency and connect the hyper-IgM immunoglobulin pattern to failure of CD40L-CD40 signaling between activated helper T cells and B cells.

reports.proposed_construct: DOCK8 deficiency impairs lymphocyte actin cytoskeletal remodeling and survival, causing combined immunodeficiency with severe cutaneous viral infections, allergy, and elevated IgE
reports.proposed_objective: Differentiate DOCK8 deficiency from STAT3-associated hyper-IgE syndrome using antiviral immunity and cytoskeletal function.

top_matches.tested_construct: WAS protein deficiency disrupts actin cytoskeleton signaling in hematopoietic cells, causing combined immunodeficiency, eczema, and microthrombocytopenia.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome from its classic triad and platelet morphology.

top_matches.tested_construct: Profound defects in T-cell development or signaling with secondary impairment of B-cell function cause severe recurrent bacterial, viral, fungal, and opportunistic infections in infancy.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize severe combined immunodeficiency.

top_matches.tested_construct: Deficiency of the platelet GPIb-IX-V complex impairs platelet adhesion to von Willebrand factor at sites of vascular injury and causes thrombocytopenia with giant platelets.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate platelet adhesion defects from aggregation defects using receptor function.

top_matches.tested_construct: Vitamin B12 deficiency impairs methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, causing megaloblastic anemia plus neurologic injury from methylmalonic acid accumulation and myelin dysfunction.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate vitamin B12 from folate deficiency using methylmalonic acid and neurologic findings.

top_matches.tested_construct: WASp links hematopoietic-cell signaling to actin-cytoskeleton remodeling. Loss of WASp disrupts immune-cell migration, phagocytosis, and immunologic-synapse formation and is associated with characteristically small platelets and thrombocytopenia.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome from eczema, recurrent infections, and small-platelet thrombocytopenia and connect the phenotype to defective WASp-mediated actin-cytoskeleton remodeling.

top_matches.tested_construct: AP3B1 deficiency causes Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome type 2, characterized by oculocutaneous albinism, platelet dense-granule dysfunction/bleeding, neutropenia, and recurrent infections.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize AP3B1-associated HPS2 from the combination of albinism, platelet dense-granule deficiency, neutropenia, and recurrent infection.

top_matches.tested_construct: CD40 ligand deficiency on activated T cells prevents B-cell class-switch recombination, causing high or normal IgM with very low IgG, IgA, and IgE.
top_matches.educational_objective: Explain hyper-IgM syndrome through defective T-cell help for B-cell class switching.

top_matches.tested_construct: Biotinidase deficiency prevents efficient recycling of biotin, reducing activity of multiple biotin-dependent carboxylases and causing neurologic and cutaneous disease.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect biotinidase deficiency with impaired carboxylase function.

reports.proposed_construct: Guanidinoacetate methyltransferase deficiency blocks methylation of guanidinoacetate to creatine, causing cerebral creatine deficiency with guanidinoacetate accumulation
reports.proposed_objective: Localize the second step of creatine synthesis and distinguish GAMT deficiency from creatine transporter deficiency.

top_matches.tested_construct: Argininosuccinate lyase deficiency blocks cleavage of argininosuccinate to arginine and fumarate, causing hyperammonemia and argininosuccinate accumulation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Localize a urea-cycle block from the accumulating intermediate.

top_matches.tested_construct: Argininosuccinate synthetase deficiency blocks condensation of citrulline with aspartate, causing citrulline accumulation and hyperammonemia.
top_matches.educational_objective: Identify argininosuccinate synthetase deficiency from hypercitrullinemia.

top_matches.tested_construct: PDE4 inhibition and cAMP degradation
top_matches.educational_objective: Use a controlled second-messenger experiment to distinguish decreased cAMP degradation from increased cAMP synthesis.

top_matches.tested_construct: Soluble guanylate cyclase stimulation rather than phosphodiesterase inhibition
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish increased second-messenger synthesis from reduced second-messenger degradation.

top_matches.tested_construct: CYP27A1 loss causing mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency with reduced bile-acid synthesis and cholestanol accumulation
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis as CYP27A1-dependent mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency that impairs bile-acid synthesis and causes cholestanol accumulation.

top_matches.tested_construct: GALT deficiency blocks conversion of galactose-1-phosphate with UDP-glucose, causing toxic galactose-1-phosphate accumulation after lactose-containing feeds.
top_matches.educational_objective: Identify GALT deficiency in a neonate who becomes ill after lactose exposure.

top_matches.tested_construct: Muscle glycogen phosphorylase deficiency prevents skeletal muscle glycogenolysis during exercise, causing cramps, exercise intolerance, and myoglobinuria with a second-wind phenomenon.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize McArdle disease from exercise-induced symptoms.

top_matches.tested_construct: Selective glucocorticoid-receptor antagonism blocks cortisol signaling
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish selective glucocorticoid-receptor antagonism from mineralocorticoid-receptor blockade.

reports.proposed_construct: Creatine transporter deficiency due to SLC6A8 loss impairs cellular uptake of creatine across the blood-brain barrier and neurons despite intact creatine synthesis
reports.proposed_objective: Distinguish defective creatine transport from AGAT and GAMT biosynthetic defects.

top_matches.tested_construct: SLC16A2 encodes MCT8, a thyroid-hormone cell-membrane transporter important for T3 entry into neurons and across blood-brain-barrier endothelium. Loss of MCT8 reduces neuronal thyroid-hormone availability despite abnormal circulating thyroid-hormone concentrations.
top_matches.educational_objective: Explain the neurologic phenotype of MCT8 deficiency as impaired thyroid-hormone transport into developing brain cells.

top_matches.tested_construct: FOLR1 encodes folate receptor alpha at the choroid plexus. Loss of function impairs folate transport across the blood-choroid-plexus-CSF barrier, producing very low CSF folate despite normal systemic folate and later-onset developmental regression, seizures, movement abnormalities, and hypomyelination.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish FOLR1 cerebral folate transport deficiency from systemic folate deficiency by recognizing very low CSF folate with normal serum folate and blood counts.

top_matches.tested_construct: Insufficient GLUT1-mediated glucose transport across the blood-brain barrier causes cerebral energy deficiency and hypoglycorrhachia despite a normal blood glucose concentration.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize GLUT1 deficiency syndrome from neurologic dysfunction plus low CSF glucose despite normal blood glucose.

top_matches.tested_construct: Transferrin-receptor binding enables receptor-mediated transcytosis across the blood-brain barrier
top_matches.educational_objective: Separate transferrin-receptor-mediated BBB transcytosis from subsequent mannose-6-phosphate-dependent lysosomal uptake.

top_matches.tested_construct: SLC2A1 encodes GLUT1, the facilitated glucose transporter that carries glucose across blood-brain-barrier endothelial cells. Reduced GLUT1 activity limits cerebral glucose delivery despite normal systemic glucose, producing hypoglycorrhachia and neurologic manifestations such as childhood seizures and paroxysmal exercise- or fasting-related movement abnormalities.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect SLC2A1/GLUT1 deficiency, hypoglycorrhachia with normal serum glucose, and neurologic symptoms to impaired facilitated glucose transport across the blood-brain barrier.

top_matches.tested_construct: Terminal complement blockade despite persistent GPI-anchor deficiency
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish terminal complement inhibition from correction of the cellular defect in PNH.

top_matches.tested_construct: SLC22A5 encodes the high-affinity OCTN2 carnitine transporter. Loss of OCTN2 impairs cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption, causing very low plasma and intracellular carnitine and limiting transport of long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria for beta-oxidation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Link primary carnitine deficiency to SLC22A5/OCTN2-mediated failure of cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption.

top_matches.tested_construct: Vitamin B12 deficiency impairs methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase reactions, producing defective DNA synthesis and accumulation of methylmalonic acid with neurologic injury.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish vitamin B12 deficiency biochemically by elevated methylmalonic acid in a patient with macrocytic anemia and neurologic findings.

reports.proposed_construct: Adenylosuccinate lyase deficiency impairs two purine-cycle reactions and causes accumulation of succinylpurines with developmental delay, seizures, and autistic features
reports.proposed_objective: Connect adenylosuccinate lyase deficiency with accumulation of succinylpurine intermediates in de novo purine synthesis.

top_matches.educational_objective: Connect XDH deficiency with failure of terminal purine oxidation, profound hypouricemia, and xanthine nephrolithiasis.

top_matches.tested_construct: CYP27A1 loss causing mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency with reduced bile-acid synthesis and cholestanol accumulation
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis as CYP27A1-dependent mitochondrial sterol 27-hydroxylase deficiency that impairs bile-acid synthesis and causes cholestanol accumulation.

top_matches.tested_construct: Vitamin B12 deficiency impairs methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase reactions, producing defective DNA synthesis and accumulation of methylmalonic acid with neurologic injury.
top_matches.educational_objective: Distinguish vitamin B12 deficiency biochemically by elevated methylmalonic acid in a patient with macrocytic anemia and neurologic findings.

top_matches.tested_construct: HGPRT deficiency blocks salvage of hypoxanthine and guanine, increasing de novo purine synthesis and uric acid production while causing severe neurologic and behavioral abnormalities.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect self-injury and hyperuricemia to defective purine salvage.

top_matches.tested_construct: UMP synthase is a bifunctional enzyme that catalyzes the last two steps of de novo pyrimidine synthesis: conversion of orotate to orotidine monophosphate and then to UMP. Deficiency causes orotic acid accumulation and impaired pyrimidine availability, producing megaloblastic anemia that does not respond to folate or vitamin B12; unlike OTC deficiency, hyperammonemia is absent.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate hereditary orotic aciduria from urea-cycle disorders and identify UMP synthase as the defective enzyme.

top_matches.tested_construct: Alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency causes lysosomal accumulation of dermatan sulfate and heparan sulfate, producing coarse features, organomegaly, skeletal disease, and developmental decline.
top_matches.educational_objective: Differentiate Hurler from Hunter syndrome using enzyme defect and corneal clouding.

top_matches.tested_construct: Argininosuccinate lyase deficiency blocks cleavage of argininosuccinate to arginine and fumarate, causing hyperammonemia and argininosuccinate accumulation.
top_matches.educational_objective: Localize a urea-cycle block from the accumulating intermediate.

top_matches.tested_construct: Abnormal development of the third and fourth pharyngeal pouches causes thymic hypoplasia and parathyroid hypoplasia, producing T-cell deficiency and hypocalcemia.
top_matches.educational_objective: Connect thymic developmental failure with T-cell immunodeficiency.
